videos.description:
Introducing Teton — engineered for the extreme. 

Built for adventures that go beyond the daily grind, the Teton Series delivers military-grade protection with 22ft (7m) drop protection, a two-piece reinforced frame, shock-absorbing bumpers, and an impact-resistant backplate. Every case ships with a snap-in holster featuring a belt clip and kickstand, so you can carry hands-free and prop your phone up on the go.
